The campus

A campus built for children to run, learn, and belong.

Twenty classrooms sit inside walled, gated grounds — with a proper playground, a basketball court, open lawns, and a paved walk lined with flags, all watched over by the same storms that roll across the fields beyond.

✓20 classrooms across a single, secure campus
✓A dedicated playground with swings, slides, and a sports court
✓Air-conditioned computer and science laboratories

From storybooks to circuit boards, Namal School's facilities are built to let curiosity move from one room to the next.
